content_of_post_to_answer: What common daily habits can make it harder to get good sleep?
answer: Many sleep problems come from habits that keep the brain in “day mode” long after the body is tired. Late-night scrolling, irregular schedules, or using the bed for work teach the mind that nighttime is still a period of activity. I’ve explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. Good sleep is less about forcing rest and more about consistently giving the brain permission to switch off.
